note: READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A `repro` VERDICT ON THIS ISSUE. This predicate does NOT test the reported symptom, and no predicate can: every kind available (regex/contains/internal_failure/nonzero_exit/timeout and the any_of/all_of combinators over them) tests the combined stdout+stderr text or the exit code, and #3005's symptom is the value of a uint32 at offset 0x28 of a FILE dxc writes. The decisive measurement is made by measure_msf.py and captured in manual-case-msf-header-*.txt; the history in verdict.json comes from that file, not from a bisect over this predicate. What this predicate does assert is positive, necessary and useful: that the build emitted a separate PDB for the reporter's flag set, and that dxc read the whole DXIL container back out of it. That makes it the feature-presence control for the byte measurement -- a release scoring no-repro here produced no readable PDB, so its bytes are not evidence about #3005 either way. It also matters that the readback succeeds: the container stream spans blocks 6..10 and block 10 is the block NumBlocks disowns, so the readback demonstrates the disowned block holds real payload and that DXC's own reader reaches it only because PDBReader (lib/DXIL/DxilPDB.cpp) never consults NumBlocks. Both clauses are positive, so nothing here can be satisfied by a compile that failed early. Controls: variant-compile-only-* runs line 1 alone and must NOT match, because a successful PDB-writing compile prints nothing whatsoever -- that control is the permanent, re-checked statement of why this predicate cannot be the symptom; variant-no-pdb-* reads a PDB that does not exist and must NOT match.
